_comment: Curated qualitative traits per image model, keyed by AKM model id. The capability registry merges this with AUTO-derived fields from the live AKM catalog (image_input from input_modalities, cost from billing, size/aspect from the param schema) - do NOT duplicate those here. Owner-maintained: edit values freely; a model with no entry falls back to safe defaults so newly-enabled AKM models still work. Scales used: fidelity/photoreal = low|medium|high|highest (reference preservation / realism), text = weak|ok|strong|strongest (typography), output = raster|vector|transparent, multi_image = can meaningfully combine 2+ refs.

gpt-image-1-mini.notes: cheap, strong instruction-follower; good text & compositing

gpt-image-1.5.notes: mid-tier OpenAI; better realism than mini

gpt-image-2.notes: best OpenAI editor/compositor; top reference fidelity

grok-imagine-image.notes: cheapest edit (edits when image attached, ≤3 refs); drifts on precise placement

gemini-2.5-flash-image.notes: Nano Banana - excellent editor/compositor, strong character/identity consistency

gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image.notes: Nano Banana 2 Lite - fast/lightweight image generation

gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview.notes: Nano Banana 2 - hi-res tiers, better text

gemini-3-pro-image-preview.notes: Nano Banana Pro - premium edit/combine, top fidelity

ideogram-v3-generate-transparent.notes: transparent PNG output - logos, stickers, cutouts

ideogram-v3-replace-background.notes: dedicated background replacement - preserves the subject, swaps bg

recraftv3_vector.notes: vector/SVG output; can vectorize an input image
